newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's July rights issues set at 561 bln won.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's July rights issues set at 561 bln won.

text.p: South Korea said on Wednesday a total of 17 companies were planning 561.3 billion won worth of rights issues in July.
The Korea Listed Companies Association said the July issues were up 9.0 percent from a year ago when 19 companies raised 514.8 billion won through rights issues.
The association said such fund-raising for August was tentatively set at 115.7 billion won by eight companies, down from 606.7 billion won a year earlier.
Rights issues would be 390.3 billion won in June, its said.
